item.title: What’s on this week in Adelaide
item.description: There's plenty on as we head into the February, so here's where you need to be this week.

item.title: New festival Constellations to fill the void left by Adelaide Writers Week cancellation
item.description: The local literary community has created Constellations, running from 28 February to 5 March, across multiple Adelaide venues.

item.title: New pizza shop Doughjo makes Neapolitan ‘classics with a twist’, but it nearly didn’t happen
item.description: Built through adversity, persistence and a lot of late nights, Doughjo is the debut pizza venture from chef Lucas Lima in Glenelg South.

item.title: FIRST LOOK: Sharehouse transforms 170-year-old Adelaide railway station into concept store with coffee, vintage, and vinyl
item.description: Sharehouse is an artist-led creative hub run by seven local artists, where coffee, vintage, nail art and tooth gems share the same space.

item.title: Adelaide weather forecast for Monday February 2nd and the days ahead
item.description: Adelaide’s 7-day forecast brings a run of sunny days and rising heat, with temperatures reaching 33°C and extreme UV levels expected.

item.title: SA victims sought after interstate arrest over classic car scam
item.description: Police are seeking South Australian victims after an interstate arrest over alleged classic car scams involving fake online advertisements and lost deposits.

item.title: Magill campus transformation sees a new hub for housing, heritage, and green spaces in Adelaide’s east
item.description: Plans have been made for a transformation of Magill campus with over 60 per cent open space, community hubs, and new housing with a focus on sustainability and preserving local heritage.

item.title: Adelaide Fringe and AirAsia partner on cheap midweek treat tickets and flight giveaways
item.description: AirAsia has partnered with Adelaide Fringe Festival to support Midweek Treat tickets, offering discounted Wednesday shows and the chance to win AirAsia flights.

item.title: UPDATED: CFS issues ‘Leave Now’ warning for uncontrolled Deep Creek bushfire
item.description: A Watch and Act warning is in place for the Deep Creek bushfire, with the blaze uncontrolled and moving towards multiple roads and local areas on the Fleurieu Peninsula.

item.title: New retirement village laws now in force across South Australia
item.description: New retirement village laws are now in effect across South Australia, delivering stronger consumer protections, clearer contracts and a new public register to support informed decision-making.
